tips: Prioritize Reels and Long video formats, as they generate exponentially higher reach and engagement compared to static pictures and standard breaking text posts.
Increase Urdu language coverage, which consistently achieves higher average engagement scores than English posts.
Focus hooks on high-impact political shifts, global military/security conflicts, and major Pakistani sports/events rather than routine regional legislative updates.
Schedule all primary posts between 12:00 UTC and 20:00 UTC, strictly avoiding the low-performing window between 00:00 UTC and 09:00 UTC.
Never post duplicate breaking news stories, and lean into Business, Europe, USA, and Science/Tech news topics over generic Americas or Asia stories.

news.summary: Aap ke page par Reels aur Long content sab se behtar perform kar rahe hain, jabke simple text aur pictures par bohat kam views hain. Urdu posts ka result English se zyaada acha hai aur shaam (12:00 se 20:00 UTC) posting ke liye best waqt hai. Hum ne Business, Europe aur USA jaise strong topics ko barha diya hai aur weak regional topics ko kam kar diya hai.

tips: Prioritize athlete awards, medal victories, and decisive milestone achievements over generic tournament previews or hosting announcements.
Produce more content in Urdu or with strong Urdu captions, as Urdu posts deliver nearly double the engagement of English posts.
Focus formats on match breakdowns, long-form reviews, and reels; drastically reduce standalone 'pic' and brief 'breaking' posts which show the lowest score averages.
Avoid niche sports like golf, cycling, and rugby; reallocate posting frequency toward wrestling, esports, snooker, and athletics.
Schedule primary posts strictly within the 12:00 to 20:00 UTC window (peak 14:00-19:00 UTC) when audience engagement is 5x to 10x higher than morning hours.
